subject: general
question: With reference to space science, which of the following planets do NOT have even one moon?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Venus and Mercury.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Venus and Mercury** are the only two planets that don't have a single natural moon orbiting them. 
 
• Mercury, the smallest and deepest planet, has no moons, or at least none that can be determined to a diameter of 1.6 km (1.0 mi).
 
• Venus also has no moons, however, reports of a moon around Venus have been deliberate since the 17th century.
 
• Earth has one moon, the biggest moon of some rocky planets in the Solar System.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mercury - 0 ( moon)
 
• Venus - 0 (moon)
 
• Earth - 1 (moon)
 
• Mars - 2 (moon)
 
• Jupiter - 95 (moon)
 
• Saturn - 146 (53 confirmed, 29 provisional) (moon)
 
• Uranus - 27 (moon)
 
• Neptune - 14​ (moon)
